diffusion_derivative: dg/dX = 0  (g(X) = 1 constant additive noise, so Milstein == Euler-Maruyama)

evaluation_thresholds.stability_check: all terminal states must satisfy |X(T)| < 1 and be finite (no NaN/Inf)

implementation_notes: FENE (finitely-extensible nonlinear elastic) Ito SDE on the open interval (-1, 1). The drift force -X/(1-X^2) diverges as |X| -> 1, confining the true process to (-1, 1) for all time. Additive unit noise (g = 1), so Milstein reduces to Euler-Maruyama. This is a STABILITY benchmark, not an accuracy benchmark: there is no closed-form solution, so analytic moments are null. A naive fixed-step Euler-Maruyama near the boundary takes a large step, overshoots past +-1, the force flips sign, and the path diverges to +-Inf / NaN. A boundary-aware ADAPTIVE step, an implicit/semi-implicit scheme, or a rejection scheme is required to keep every path inside (-1, 1). The independent check confirms only that every terminal state satisfies |X(T)| < 1 and is finite. Return terminal_paths (shape (num_paths,)) plus empirical mean and variance of X(T) at T = 1.
